sign_constraint.statement: S3 triangle holonomy is a transposition exactly when its sign around that triangle is odd

base_automorphism_quotient.status: not enumerated globally; reduced to the induced finite action on 2^64 sign classes and their twisted-F3 projective fibers

execution: independent spanning-tree reconstruction of the Pass4716 S3 voltage connection; exact GF(2) rank of the 270 triangle-sign equations; exact Burnside count for residual global S3 conjugation; exhaustive radius-one same-sign deformation check
theorem: The all-270-triangles-transposition rule leaves a 64-dimensional affine space of binary sign classes. For each sign class the residual A3 choices form connected vertex-gauge classes of cardinality (3^225-1)/2. Thus the triangle rule is extremely non-rigid: even before quotienting by the 51840 base automorphisms there are 2^64*(3^225-1)/2 connected gauge classes, and all 452 one-edge same-sign perturbations of the selected tree-gauge representative remain connected.
boundary: Complete classification modulo vertex gauge; quotient by the full base automorphism group is a further finite orbit problem and is not claimed solved here.
